author: Nick Bellows
description:
Detects a registry value written under a Run, RunOnce or Policies\Explorer\Run key whose data
points at a user-writable location (AppData, Temp, Users\Public) or launches a script host or
shell. Atomic Red Team T1547.001 tests 1, 3, 9, 12 and 13 write such values. Values that point
at Program Files binaries are excluded because that is how legitimate software registers tray
agents; the trade-off is documented in the writeup. Startup-folder variants (tests 4-7) are file
writes, not registry sets, and are out of scope for this rule.
ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2 and the Atomic test catalog were accessed 2026-08-29.
false_positives: Per-user applications installed under AppData (some chat and update agents) register Run values there; allowlist by value name and signer after review.
Enterprise logon scripts pushed through the Policies\Explorer\Run key.
name: SIGMA - Run Key Persistence Pointing at a User-Writable Path or Script Host
query: winlog.channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational AND (event.code:13 AND ((registry.path:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\* OR *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\* OR *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run\\*)) AND (winlog.event_data.Details:(*\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *powershell* OR *pwsh* OR *cmd.exe\ \/c* OR *cmd\ \/c* OR *mshta* OR *wscript* OR *cscript* OR *rundll32* OR *regsvr32* OR *.vbs* OR *.js* OR *.bat* OR *.ps1* OR *.hta*))))
